title: the gun keys are named 1-8, 0 everywhere
why: The gun keys are 1 to 8 and 0 (the rocket launcher took 0 and key 9 does nothing), but the controls list, the compact list, the pause line, the demo controls card and the stash key row still said 1-9, and a gun put on the wrong key was told guns go on keys 1 to 9. The number-key bind in the stash had the same mix-up: with a gun under the cursor key 9 bound the rocket launcher key and key 0 did nothing.
now: Every list names the gun keys 1-8, 0, a gun on the wrong key is told guns go on keys 1 to 8 and 0, and in the stash key 0 binds the gun under the cursor to the rocket launcher key while key 9 does nothing.

edits.replacement:
var d=(ev.key==='0')?8:ev.key.charCodeAt(0)-49;                 // v31.xx (cw-gunkeys19): '1' -> 0 up to '8' -> 7, and '0' is the ninth gun key (the rocket launcher, cw-gunkeys0); '9' does nothing
  if(ev.key.length!==1||d<0||d>8||ev.key==='9') return;
